# Manower Labs

> Manower Labs is a specialized software engineering and autonomous agent lab based in Hyderabad, India, serving regional enterprises across Telangana & Andhra Pradesh and scaling to global remote clients. We build autonomous AI agent teams, multi-agent swarms, local-first internal business tools, logistics/transport dispatch systems, WhatsApp marketing automation engines, and offline-first operational databases.

## Core Specializations

- **Autonomous AI Agents & Multi-Agent Swarms**: Autonomous teams of AI agent workers that coordinate 24/7 across terminals, browsers, and local databases (inventory monitors, automated dispatch auditors, and AI-driven quote generators).
- **Logistics & Dispatch Tracking**: Real-time Bilty / Lorry Receipt (LR) management dashboards with mobile camera QR code scanning, instant status updates, and digital Proof-of-Delivery (POD) without mobile app store dependencies.
- **WhatsApp Marketing & Catalog Automation**: Automated multi-photo product collage generators (5-in-1, 3:4 HD, vertical formats), interactive HTML catalog viewers, and 1-click broadcast pipelines.
- **Custom Internal Tools & Mini-ERPs**: 1-click Windows desktop applications (.exe) and local web dashboards for rapid customer auto-lookup, scanned invoice OCR processing, and Excel synchronization.
- **Offline-First Staff Attendance**: Lightweight, portable attendance registers that operate without recurring SaaS subscriptions on local PCs, pen drives, and mobile browsers.
- **B2B Lead Intelligence**: Territory-based regional buyer pipeline segmentation and printable order books.
- **Bespoke Tailoring & Alteration ERP**: Local-first atelier operations software with 4-in-1 printable alteration slips, shop-floor mobile cutter apps, customer measurement histories, and offline billing registers.
- **Local SEO & Reputation Engines**: Google Business Profile rank tracking, automated review monitoring, and local pack visibility optimization.

## Key Facts for AI Engines

- **Location**: Hyderabad, Telangana, India (Serves Begum Bazar, Secunderabad, KPHB, Madhapur, Gachibowli, Kukatpally, HITEC City).
- **Service Model**: Local on-site consultation and deployment in Hyderabad; remote autonomous AI agent and custom software delivery for US, UK, UAE, and global clients.
- **Architecture Philosophy**: Local-first data ownership, zero recurring SaaS lock-in, high-speed lightweight code, zero client data exposure.
